Settings

Some cosmetic settings for the site.

— tile skill trees to reduce space (experimental)
— reduce render size of skill trees
— show skill trees horizontally

About

Welcome to the new MWO Skill Tree/Grid tool, to help plan out and share skill point allocations.

MWO revamped its skill system in late-2022. If you're looking for the older Skill Tree, visit mwoskill.

  • source code @gitlab
  • reddit

MWOSkill2 was created for non-commercial purposes, referencing assets from MechWarrior Online. This tool is not endorsed by nor reflects the views or opinions of Piranha Games Inc. and no employee of Piranha Games Inc. was involved in the making of it.
